item.title: Pro-Palestinian group protests outside local Tesco in support of suspended worker
item.description: A pro-Palestinian group held a demonstration outside Tesco in Roscommon yesterday after one of its stores suspended an employee for refusing to handle Israeli goods. Protestors across Ireland have called for the retailer to withdraw disciplinary action against the employee in County Down. A petition, which has collected several thousand signatures, was also set up in support of the worker. Twelve people attended the protest at the Roscommon store yesterday. item.title: Local region braced for Storm Bram
item.description: Local authorities are gearing up for what could potentially be a busy 36 hours with Storm Bram on the way. County Leitrim has been included in a status orange wind warning from tomorrow. Met Éireann say it will bring very strong winds. Advertisement Other impacts could include difficult travel conditions, debris, displaced loose objects and impacted outdoor events. The orange warning will take effect from 10am tomorrow until 6pm. item.title: Dangerous driving conditions expected during weather warnings
item.description: Met Eireann is warning of dangerous driving conditions in the Shannonside region tomorrow, as Storm Bram arrives. Longford, Leitrim and Roscommon will be under a status yellow wind warming from 3 o'clock in the morning. Leitrim's will be upgraded to orange at 10am, and the alerts will remain in place until the evening. item.title: Over 300 on Leitrim's housing waiting list
item.description: It's emerged there are 302 households on county Leitrim's housing waiting list. The data highlights a persistent and growing demand for housing supports across the region, with particular pressure evident in Carrick-on-Shannon and its surrounding areas. The Carrick MD accounts for over one-third of the county’s total housing need, with 111 households awaiting accommodation. item.title: Christmas crackdown sees five Longford drink-driving arrests
item.description: Five people were arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence in Longford in the first six days of a Christmas campaign. Longford Gardaí say they are conducting additional checkpoints in the county ahead of the festive period. Gardaí in the Longford District say they are conducting checkpoints from early morning until late at night throughout the festive period. item.title: Calls to halt livestock moves amid growing bluetongue crisis
item.description: There are calls for livestock to be banned from moving from the North to the Republic due to the bluetongue crisis. The North's Department of Agriculture is responding to a new suspected case of Bluetongue detected on a farm near Greyabbey in County Down. It follows more than 40 confirmed cases found in the Bangor area last week. item.title: Entire Shannonside region hit with orange weather warnings
item.description: The entire Shannonside region will be under status orange wind warnings tomorrow. These alerts will hit Longford, Leitrim and Roscommon from 10am to 9pm. Lesser status yellow warnings apply to these counties from 6am to 10am tomorrow. Advertisement Met Éireann says Storm Bram will bring very strong to gale force southerly winds with severe gusts.
